debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging for troubleshooting.

log_level.description: Global logging level. Choose from: trace, debug, info, warn, error.

pid_file.description: File path where the daemon writes its process ID.

socket_path.description: Unix domain socket path for local client communication.

worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads handling concurrent device and client operations.

device_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for communication with biometric devices.

io_buffer_size.description: Size (bytes) of internal I/O buffers for device communication.

max_sessions.description: Maximum number of concurrent device sessions.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for failed device operations.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS for encrypted communication (if the daemon supports network endpoints).

tls_cert_path.description: Path to the TLS server certificate file.

tls_key_path.description: Path to the TLS private key file.

ca_cert_path.description: Optional path to CA certificate for mutual TLS client authentication. Leave empty to disable client cert validation.

allowed_clients.description: List of allowed client IP addresses or subnets (CIDR notation). Empty list = allow all clients.
